appearance_facts.fact: Chart title: 'Prevalence of Species Z in US States'
Legend: color scale from 'Low' (dark red) to 'High' (light yellow), with numerical markers at 0, 20, 40, 60, 80, 100
Georgia (GA) is colored dark red, indicating the highest prevalence category (0-20 range on the scale)
Rhode Island (RI) is also colored dark red, indicating the highest prevalence category (0-20 range on the scale)
Delaware (DE) is colored orange, indicating a mid-range prevalence (approximately 40-60 range on the scale)
Several other states, including Nevada (NV), Wyoming (WY), Oklahoma (OK), and Illinois (IL), are also colored dark red
